title: TesseraQL Simple YAML v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL Simple YAML documents: routes (web/**/<method>.yml), jobs (batch/**/job.yml), queue consumers (consume/**), and declarative views (*.view.yml).
$comment: additionalProperties stays true so newer keys never break older editors; the route recipe enum is kept in sync with the linter by a build-time test.

id.description: Unique document id, e.g. products.page; referenced by tests, coverage, governance approvals, and logs.

kind.description: route/job/view (this schema's shapes), workflow/scope/attachment (their own trees), and the mcp/ kinds tool/resource/ui/prompt, which reuse the route model.

recipe.description: What the document does: query-json/command-json (JSON APIs), query-html/page (HTML pages), query-export/file-import/file-export (file transfers), webhook (inbound webhooks), queue-consume (consume/** documents), the job recipes batch-tasklet/batch-pipeline, and the view recipes list/form/detail/dashboard (kind: view).

input.description: Declared input fields - one contract for routes and jobs alike (a job's parameters bind and validate exactly like a route's). Documented in app-layout.md and jobs.md.

inputPolicy.description: Route-level input handling policy (e.g. unknown-field behavior) layered over the deny-by-default input: contract.

unknownFields.description: How to treat request fields with no declared input: reject (default) or ignore.

readOnlyFieldBehavior.description: How to treat declared but non-writable fields when present: reject (default), ignore, or warn.

auth.description: bearer | browser | api-key | mtls | public (deny-by-default: no auth means no access to protected data).

csrf.description: CSRF posture: auto (browser state-changing routes are protected), required, or off - one enum here and in security.defaults rules alike.

security.description: How this document authenticates and authorizes. Routes are deny-by-default: one that declares no security is unreachable. Documented in authentication.md.

idempotency.description: Idempotent replay for commands. A replayed key returns the stored response; a reused key with a different body is TQL-IDEM-4090. Documented in transactional-writes.md.

required.description: Whether the Idempotency-Key header is required on this command.

scope.description: The replay scope key (default: the route id).

ttl.description: How long a stored response replays (duration string, default 24h).

admission.description: Admission policy for this route: concurrency, rate limiting, and the execution lane. Documented in productivity.md (admission) and jobs.md (lanes).

maxInFlight.description: Maximum requests of this route in flight at once; excess is rejected.

concurrency.description: Bound on how many of this route's requests run at once.

requestsPerSecond.description: Sustained requests per second allowed; excess is refused with 429.

scope.description: node (default) limits per runtime node; cluster coordinates through the shared lease store (TQL-YAML-1023).

rateLimit.description: Token-bucket rate limit for this route.

lane.description: The execution lane this route runs on (tesseraql.lanes).

outbox.description: Transactional outbox event recorded with the command and delivered at-least-once after commit. Documented in notifications.md and messaging.md.

enrich.description: Reference lookups folded into a result set's rows (docs/lookups.md): the rows of `into` carry a key, the reference behind that key is fetched in batches of distinct keys, and the match is composed into each row. One statement per `batchSize` keys rather than one per row.

into.description: The result set to enrich: `sql` (the default) or one of the route's `queries:` (TQL-YAML-1045).

on.description: The join, one entry per key column: each row column to the reference column it matches. The row side is the key that is looked up; the reference side names the columns bound as `keys`.

sql.description: The reference query. The distinct keys bind as `keys`: a value list for a single-column key, a list of rows keyed by the reference column names for a composite one. The file must bind them (TQL-YAML-1048). Exactly one of `sql` or `http` is the reference.

http.description: The reference call, in the vocabulary every outbound call shares, plus `select` and `onError`. Exactly one of `sql` or `http` is the reference. A `perRow` call may key its url with `{key.<column>}` placeholders, percent-encoded per path segment; a `batch` call carries the whole key set as `keys`.

mode.description: How an HTTP reference is fetched: `perRow` (the default — one request per distinct key, for a resource keyed per URL) or `batch` (one request per `batchSize` keys, for an endpoint that accepts a key list). A SQL reference is always batched.

as.description: Attach the matching reference rows as a list under this field; exactly one of `as` or `merge` composes the match (TQL-YAML-1047).

merge.description: Copy these columns of the single matching reference row onto each row, for a many-to-one reference; the alternative to `as`.

batchSize.description: Distinct keys per statement. Defaults from the dialect and the key arity, under Oracle's 1000-expression IN limit and SQL Server's 2100 parameters.

maxKeys.description: The ceiling on distinct keys, beyond which the enrichment fails (TQL-SQL-2114) rather than issuing an unbounded number of round trips. Defaults to 10000.

http.description: Named HTTP sources on a query route (docs/connectors.md, "HTTP sources"): each is a body-less GET against an external JSON API, executed through the outbound gateway (deny-by-default allowedHosts, named credentials, timeouts, circuit breaker) and composed with the SQL results in the response or view as <name>.rows / <name>.body. Query recipes only (TQL-YAML-1022).

method.description: The HTTP method, defaulting to GET. A reference API that takes a key list or a query document (POST .../search, JSON-RPC, GraphQL) declares its own; a non-GET method is written out, never inferred from `body`.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL; config placeholders resolve. The host must be in tesseraql.http.outbound.allowedHosts (TQL-SEC-4070).

body.description: A source expression resolving to the JSON request body. Declaring it beside a method that carries no body (GET, HEAD) is a build error (TQL-YAML-1049).

headers.description: Static request headers sent with the call. Credential material belongs in a named credential, never here.

query.description: Query-string bindings, each an expression over the execution context.

expectStatus.description: The HTTP status the response must carry; any other status fails the call.

connectTimeout.description: How long to wait for the connection (duration string such as `2s`).

requestTimeout.description: How long to wait for the complete response (duration string such as `10s`).

select.description: Dotted path into the response JSON naming the rows array or object the source exposes.

readOnly.description: The author's assertion that the call has no side effect. Required on a transactional recipe (TQL-YAML-1050): the call is made before the transaction and a rollback cannot un-make it.

onError.description: fail (default) or empty: the source degrades to zero rows and the page still renders.

cache.description: Declarative HTTP caching for query responses (docs/response-shaping.md): Cache-Control from maxAge/visibility (private default; public lints onto auth: public only) and a content ETag answering If-None-Match with 304. Query recipes only (TQL-YAML-1025).

maxAge.description: How long a client may reuse the response (duration string such as 30s or 5m).

visibility.description: `private` (the default) lets only the client cache the response; `public` permits shared caches and lints onto `auth: public` routes only.

etag.description: Hash the rendered body and answer If-None-Match with 304 (default true).

staleWhileRevalidate.description: How long a stale response may still be served while it revalidates (duration string).

emit.description: Topic(s) broadcast to live views after this command commits (docs/realtime.md). A name is lowercase dot/dash-separated segments; the event carries the topic name only, never data.

invalidates.description: Source table(s) whose code catalogs this command's write makes stale (docs/lookups.md). Named by table, not by catalog: a maintenance screen for a shared code master writes a row whose kind is request data, so which catalog is affected is not known until the write happens. Dropped after the commit, so a rollback invalidates nothing.

refreshOn.description: List, detail, and dashboard views (not forms): refetch this view's refresh region whenever a command emits this topic (docs/realtime.md).

datasource.description: The named connector under tesseraql.datasources the route's SQL runs on, defaulting to main. The name must be declared (TQL-YAML-1035); a non-main route cannot declare notify:/publish:/outbox: or sequence allocation - they ride the main connector (TQL-YAML-1036).

sql.description: The document's single statement: a colocated 2-way SQL file, a named IAM contract, or a service call. Its result binds as `rows`.

steps.description: Named statements executed in order inside one transaction (command recipes). Each result binds under `steps.<name>`. Documented in transactional-writes.md.

queries.description: Additional named queries executed after sql, each bound into the execution context under its name.

validate.description: Declarative validation rules keyed by rule id. A rule declares exactly one of rule: (a cross-field expression), file: (validation SQL), or use: (a shared rule declared under rules/). Honored on command-json, query-json and webhook routes, on queue consumers, and on MCP tools.

rule.description: A cross-field expression that must hold.

file.description: Validation SQL returning one row per violation; must be a SELECT, and runs inside the command's transaction.

use.description: Name of a shared rule declared under rules/. The reference supplies params: matching the rule's binds: contract, plus its own field:/when:/code:/message:.

params.description: Binds for a SQL rule, as dotted source expressions.

field.description: The input the violation is reported against.

when.description: Guard expression; the rule is skipped when it is falsy.

decide.description: Decision-table references keyed by alias, evaluated once per operation before the validate: rules; outputs publish as decision.<alias>.<output> for SQL binds and directives. Documented in decision-tables.md.

use.description: Name of a decision declared under decisions/.

params.description: Wiring of each decision input to a request-context expression (params.total, principal.orgUnit, "principal.role == 'officer'").

effectiveAt.description: Reference instant of a dated table-backed decision's effective: window - audit.now unless wired to a document date (params.postingDate).

notify.description: Notifications enqueued with the command on the transactional outbox, keyed by notification id; each entry names its channel: (a workflow reminder is the separate reminders: key). Documented in notifications.md.

errors.description: Per-route error mapping: constraint codes and statuses onto response fields and messages. Documented in declarative-validation.md.

import.description: file-import parsing and column-to-bind mapping (headerRow, startRow, columns, onError: rollback|skip). Documented in file-transfers.md.

export.description: query-export / file-export output: format (csv, excel, pdf), filename, columns with headers and format patterns, locale/timezone. Documented in file-transfers.md.

provider.description: A verifier under tesseraql.connectors.webhooks (an unknown provider fails the build).

webhook.description: Inbound webhook verification and payload mapping for a `webhook` route. Documented in connectors.md.

channel.description: The declared messaging channel to publish on.

topic.description: The topic the event is published under.

key.description: Ordering key for the event, as a bindable path; messages sharing a key keep their relative order.

payload.description: The event body: each property name to the bindable path supplying its value.

publish.description: The domain event this command publishes on a messaging channel after commit, on the same transactional outbox as `notify:`. Documented in messaging.md.

channel.description: The declared messaging channel to consume from.

topic.description: The topic this consumer subscribes to.

idempotencyKey.description: A bindable path over the message whose value de-duplicates redeliveries, so an at-least-once channel applies each message once.

consume.description: What a `consume/**` document subscribes to. Documented in messaging.md.

pagination.description: Declarative pagination: the framework appends the dialect clause; authored SQL carries no LIMIT/FETCH.

strategy.description: `offset` (the default) pages by row offset; `keyset` pages by the `by:` cursor column and stays stable while rows are inserted.

size.description: Page size used when the request does not ask for one.

maxSize.description: Largest page size a request may ask for; a larger request is clamped.

count.description: Also run a count query so the response carries the total row count.

status.description: The status answered on success (default 200; a create conventionally declares 201).

body.description: What the response body is: a bindable path such as `rows` or `steps.<name>`, or a literal shape composing several.

fields.description: Per-field visibility, masking, and classification applied to the body. Documented in data-scoping.md.

statusWhen.description: Conditional statuses: the first entry whose expression matches decides the status.

into.description: The parent collection the children are nested into.

children.description: The named query under `queries:` supplying the child rows.

as.description: The property name the children appear under on each parent row; one of `as` or `merge` composes the match.

merge.description: Columns of the single matching child row to copy onto each parent row, for a many-to-one reference; the alternative to `as`.

on.description: The join: each parent property to the child property it matches, one entry per key column.

nest.description: Compose the rows of a named query into the parent rows, so one request answers a parent-and-children shape without a second endpoint.

json.description: The JSON response: status, body, per-field policy, and nested composition.

template.description: The Thymeleaf template to render, relative to the app template root (exclusive with `view:`).

view.description: The id of a *.view.yml document (exclusive with template:).

shell.description: Shell negotiation: auto (default) serves the bare #page-content region to htmx requests and the shell-wrapped page to direct navigation; always wraps unconditionally; never declares an htmx-only region endpoint.

views.description: View ids whose models a template: route binds; each renders into views['<id>'] for the template to insert (illegal alongside view:).

model.description: Extra model entries for the template: each name to the bindable path supplying it.

headers.description: Response headers to set, merged over the app-wide `responseHeaders` defaults.

headersWhen.description: Conditional response headers: the first entry whose expression matches decides the headers.

statusWhen.description: Conditional statuses: the first entry whose expression matches decides the status.

html.description: The HTML response: a template or a view, its model, the status, and headers.

filename.description: The download filename offered to the client, as a literal or a bindable path.

stream.description: Stream the generated file back as the response body (`query-export`). Documented in file-transfers.md.

status.description: The redirect status; declare `303` after a command so the browser follows with GET.

location.description: Where to redirect, as a literal path or a bindable path.

redirect.description: Answer with a redirect instead of a body — the usual close of a browser form post.

template.description: The template rendered into the file.

contentType.description: The Content-Type of the produced file.

filename.description: The download filename offered to the client, as a literal or a bindable path.

model.description: Extra model entries for the template: each name to the bindable path supplying it.

file.description: Render a template into a file and answer with it as a download.

retarget.description: The element an error response replaces, instead of the request target.

reswap.description: The htmx swap style an error response uses (for example `outerHTML`).

onError.description: How an error response reaches htmx, so a failed submit lands in the right place instead of replacing the page. Documented in response-shaping.md.

rotate.description: Re-issue the caller's session cookie in place on success: a fresh id and CSRF token, the old id invalidated before the response leaves. Declare on routes that elevate the session (confirming an MFA enrollment); bearer or public callers are untouched.

response.description: How the result becomes an HTTP response: JSON, HTML, a redirect, a stream, or a rendered file. Documented in response-shaping.md.

title.description: The heading a view document renders (`kind: view`).

template.description: The pattern override a view document renders through instead of its bundled `tql/view/*` pattern (`kind: view`, customization ladder L2). Resolved beside the view document, then under the app template root. Documented in declarative-views.md.

search.description: The input field a list view binds its search box to.

source.description: The id of the route a view reads its rows from.

action.description: The id of the route a form view submits to.

columns.description: The columns a list view renders, in order. Documented in declarative-views.md.

fields.description: The fields a form or detail view renders, in order. Documented in declarative-views.md.

panels.description: The panels a dashboard view composes, in order. Documented in declarative-views.md.

children.description: Views embedded inside this one, keyed by the slot each fills. Documented in declarative-views.md.

slots.description: Named regions this view exposes for a composing parent to fill. Documented in declarative-views.md.

trigger.description: How a job starts (kind: job): a schedule, or a directory/SFTP/FTPS poll source feeding the import: pipeline. Documented in jobs.md and connectors.md.

cron.description: A Quartz cron expression; firings are claimed cluster-wide so one node runs each.

fixedDelay.description: A period (duration string, e.g. 5m); mutually exclusive with cron.

calendar.description: A business-day calendar declared under calendars/ - the cron says when to consider a firing, the calendar says whether it counts. Documented in jobs.md.

runOn.description: Which considered firings count under the calendar (default business-day); mutually exclusive with dayOfMonth.

dayOfMonth.description: The shifted nominal-day rule: fire on this day of month, or its shifted business day when it is not one - and the run's business date is the nominal date. Rounds down to the month's last day. Documented in jobs.md.

shift.description: Where a non-business nominal day moves (default next-business-day); requires dayOfMonth.

schedule.description: Fire the job on a clock: a cron expression or a fixed delay, optionally filtered by a business-day calendar.

transport.description: local (default) polls a directory under connectors.poll.allowedPaths; sftp/ftps poll a remote host in connectors.poll.allowedHosts.

host.description: The remote host to poll; required for `sftp` and `ftps`, and it must be listed in `connectors.poll.allowedHosts`.

port.description: The remote port; defaults to the transport's standard port.

path.description: The polled directory. A local path must sit under a declared allowedPaths root. A remote path with a leading slash is absolute on the server; without one it resolves against the credential's login home.

credential.description: A named credential under tesseraql.connectors.poll.credentials (required for remote sources).

move.description: Relative directory for processed files (default .done). Plain names only - no paths or placeholders.

moveFailed.description: Relative directory for failed files (default .error). Plain names only.

poll.description: Fire the job when files arrive: a local directory, SFTP, or FTPS source feeding the job's import pipeline.

after.description: Light chaining: fire when the named job's execution completes successfully in the same app, carrying its business date. Documented in jobs.md.

overlap.description: What a firing does while the previous execution still runs (kind: job): skip (default) records a SKIPPED execution naming the running one; concurrent runs anyway - declare it only for jobs that are safe to overlap. Documented in jobs.md.

sla.description: Deadline expectations a periodic managed check alerts on through the alerts channel (kind: job) - alert-only, nothing is killed. Documented in jobs.md.

completeBy.description: Wall-clock time (HH:mm) by which a day's run must have completed for that business date.

runningLongerThan.description: A duration (e.g. 2h) beyond which a still-running execution raises the alert.

perTenant.description: Run this job once per configured tenant, each on its own datasource and tenant context (kind: job). Documented in multi-tenancy.md.

pipeline.description: A batch-pipeline job's ordered steps (exactly one of sql, notify, httpCall, chunk, export, or push per step), each publishing its result to the step context. Documented in jobs.md.

domain.description: Name of a field domain declared under domains/; its type, bounds, pattern, format, enum, classification and mask merge in, and the keys declared here win. Operational keys (required, requiredWhen, default, writable) stay route-local.

type.description: The declared type. A supplied value is coerced to it and refused when it does not fit.

required.description: Refuse the request when this field is absent.

default.description: The value bound when the request omits the field.

pattern.description: Anchored regular expression (TQL-YAML-1012 when it does not compile).

format.description: string: email|uuid|url; date/number: a parse pattern.

enum.description: The accepted values; anything else is refused.

writable.description: `false` makes the field read-only: it renders in a derived form but is never bound from the request.

classification.description: Data classification label carried into masking and audit. Documented in data-scoping.md.

mask.description: The masking rule applied when the principal may not see the value.

widget.description: Presentation hint (docs/declarative-views.md): the form widget this field renders as, declared once on a domain; a per-view fields: override wins. Never part of the HTTP contract.

codes.description: The code catalog this field's values come from (docs/lookups.md): the binder accepts only that catalog's active codes, and the violation is the enum field error. Declared on a domain, so the value set has one home instead of an enum that drifts from the master.

policy.description: Write authorization (docs/declarative-views.md): a security policy the principal must satisfy to supply this field; a failing principal's value follows the route's readOnly behavior, and the derived form omits the field. Operational — never accepted inside a domain.

enum.description: The accepted element values; anything else is refused.

file.description: A colocated 2-way SQL file (must exist; TQL-SQL-2103).

contract.description: A named IAM SQL contract to execute instead of a colocated file, so an app can reuse the identity schema statements. Legal on sql: and queries:, and refused inside a command step. Documented in authentication.md.

service.description: A named runtime service provider to call instead of running SQL (docs/extending.md). Legal on sql: and queries:, and refused inside a command step — a transactional step must be a SQL file or a sequence.

mode.description: How the statement runs and what it binds: `query` (rows), `query-one` (a single row), `update` (an affected-row count), or `query-spool` (a streamed result).

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-binding SQL statement timeout override; 0 disables. Default: tesseraql.sql.timeoutSeconds, else 30s.

datasource.description: The named connector this read binding runs on, overriding the route's connector. A step inside a transactional pipeline cannot pick its own connector (TQL-YAML-1037).

when.description: Guard expression on a command step: a falsy guard skips the step, recording steps.<name>.skipped. The declared branch point for decision.* outputs (docs decision-tables); not legal on the single-statement sql: form.

params.description: Arguments for a `service:` or `contract:` call: each name to the bindable path supplying its value.

sequence.description: Allocate the next value of a managed document-number sequence instead of running SQL; it binds as `steps.<name>.value`. Documented in transactional-writes.md.

keys.description: Columns whose database-generated values are captured after an insert; they bind as `steps.<name>.keys.<column>`.

maxRows.description: Largest number of rows materialized. Default: `tesseraql.resultMaterialization.maxRows`.

onOverflow.description: `fail` (the default) refuses a result past `maxRows`; `warn` truncates it and logs.

materialize.description: Bounds on how much of the result is held in memory.

rowCount.description: The exact number of rows the statement must affect (rows is a list of records everywhere else).

onMismatch.description: `conflict` (the default) answers 409, so a stale edit is refused honestly; `error` answers 500.

expect.description: The row count this statement must affect, and what happens when it does not — the declarative optimistic-locking check on an update or delete.

visible.description: `false` removes the field from the response entirely, for every caller.

policy.description: The security policy a principal must satisfy to see the value unmasked.

mask.description: The masking rule applied when the policy is not satisfied, such as showing only the last four characters.

classification.description: Data classification label carried into audit. Documented in data-scoping.md.

unmaskWhen.description: An expression that, when it matches, reveals the value despite the mask.

when.description: A whitelist-only expression over the execution context; the first matching entry wins.

status.description: The HTTP status to answer when the expression is truthy.
